after_contact.reason: The slide did not decelerate steadily up the deck (bounce or tumble). Fitted on the plain deck before the hole.

into_hole.label: Into the hole
into_hole.note: The bag hung on the lip for 0.62 s, then dropped through the hole. It shrank from view as it tipped in.

model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 7.4 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 30.1 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (7% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
